hints.title: Single Pass Trend Invariant
hints.text: An array is monotonic if it nowhere decreases or nowhere increases between adjacent elements.

hints.title: Dual Directional Flags
hints.text: Maintain two boolean flags indicating whether the sequence could be non-decreasing and whether it could be non-increasing.

hints.title: Adjacent Comparison Verification
hints.text: Scan adjacent elements from start to finish. Invalidate non-decreasing if an element drops, and invalidate non-increasing if an element rises.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting a copy to compare equality takes O(N log N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check non-decreasing and non-increasing conditions in one pass.
